card.name: Connectors inside dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Small connecting pieces inside dosing and dose-modification text, such as 'or' between options, a hyphen in 'ramp-up', or a digit in a number. They sit next to doses, grades and lab limits.

modes.label: 'or' between options
modes.description: The word 'or' joins routes or grade thresholds in dosing directions.
modes.example: Premedicate with dexamethasone 4 mg orally<< or>> intravenously twice daily for 3

modes.label: Inside numbers and compounds
modes.description: A digit or hyphen partway through a number or compound term in a dosing or lab context.
modes.example: amylase and/or lipase levels return to 1.<<5>> times the ULN

modes.label: Hyphen in formula or name
modes.description: A hyphen or word start inside a formula or a named scale.
modes.example: mL/min) = Weight (kg) × (140 - age) 72 × serum creatinine (mg/dL) Women<< ->> 0.85 × the value
